CustomField.description: What CFO Bot reads (never the lookup itself): a markdown link, [training name](learning portal page), to the Training Resource, or blank. Blank unless EVERY employee can open the training from a link, the Learning Portal's own rule (tccfo-lms canOpen): not Restrict from Knowledge Base, in CFO Bot's knowledge base (File ID set) and in a numbered training section. So a restricted training's name never reaches staff who can't open it. A cross-object formula, so the proxy's integration user needs no access to Training Resources.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What CFO Bot shows. Blank when the training is restricted or not yet in a numbered Learning Portal section.
CustomField.label: Training Link
